rationale: Programmed and DLS Group Civils 36-month paid civil construction traineeship in Rowville with a Certificate III; entry level, no construction experience needed.
Marc's site work in the Philippines (inspections, coordinating crews, reading drawings) and his White Card, licence and transport match what the advert asks for.
Victoria based, though Rowville is across Melbourne from Melton; the work is hands-on labouring rather than drafting or coordination.
caution: Overqualified for a Certificate III labouring traineeship (BSCE and Advanced Diploma); a formal traineeship may not suit someone who already holds a higher civil qualification.
gaps: Hands-on labouring role rather than drafting, documentation or site coordination
Rowville is a long commute from Melton
mandatory_unresolved: The traineeship runs 36 months but Marc's Subclass 485 work rights end December 2027; the advert does not say whether a temporary visa holder can be signed up to the traineeship
apply_instructions: Apply through SEEK (links out to Programmed).
title: Civil Construction Traineeship
